title: Talk it through 1.3
role: Tour operator solving a booking problem with a customer-service representative
can_do: I can describe a service problem that is still going on.
I can state what I need clearly and politely, and ask for a fee to be waived.

nodes.partner_line: Customer service, good afternoon. How can I help you?
nodes.translation: Servicio al cliente, buenas tardes. ¿En qué puedo ayudarle?

options.text: I am calling about a problem that has been going on for a week.
I would like to report a problem with our group booking.
I am writing on behalf of a cooperative whose account is blocked.

nodes.partner_line: I am sorry to hear that. What exactly has been happening?
nodes.translation: Lamento oír eso. ¿Qué ha estado pasando exactamente?
nodes.model_reply: Our bookings have been cancelled without any notice.

nodes.partner_line: I see. Have you contacted us about this before?
nodes.translation: Entiendo. ¿Ya nos había contactado antes por esto?

options.text: Yes, I have been writing to you since Monday.
Yes, twice, and nobody has replied.
No, this is the first time I am calling.

nodes.partner_line: What would you like us to do?

options.text: I would like you to restore the bookings today.
We require a clear answer within twenty-four hours.
I am asking you to escalate this to a manager.

nodes.partner_line: There may be a cancellation fee on some of the tickets.
nodes.translation: Puede haber un cargo por cancelación en algunos de los billetes.

options.text: We would be grateful if the fee could be waived.
I would like to ask for the fee to be waived, given the circumstances.
Could you check whether the fee might be waived in this case?

nodes.partner_line: I will escalate this now and call you back within the hour.
nodes.translation: Lo escalaré ahora y le devolveré la llamada en una hora.

options.text: Thank you. I would appreciate a confirmation in writing.
Thank you, I will wait for your call.
That is helpful. Please send me the case number as well.
